tldr.hook: Cyclone Akvan came ashore near Gopalpur after more than 300,000 moved to shelters.
points: Winds were 70-80 kph with gusts up to 90 kph, the weather department said.
No deaths were reported; Odisha's relief commissioner reported no damage or untoward incident.
The weather department expected the storm to weaken into a deep depression over next three hours.

links.title: India's eastern coast hit by third cyclone within a month

stories.summary: The storm crossed the coast near Gopalpur from about 8 am after more than 300,000 people were moved to shelters. No deaths were reported. (IMD, Deccan Herald)

Anthropic raised about $81.3 billion in the largest IPO on record, pricing shares at $83

tldr.hook: UK and EU conclude a reset deal covering food trade, youth visas and carbon link.
points: The agreements cover youth mobility, food trade rules, and an emissions trading link.
Both sides agreed timelines for implementing them; details are due in a joint statement.
Legal processes in each country will now take place, and talks will continue on some areas.

tldr.hook: COP31 nears its final day with no deal; countries demand fossil fuel action.
points: France, Panama and others challenged the draft, citing missing fossil fuels and climate finance.
Panama said it would formally object to any COP31 agreement without fossil fuels language.
No new draft was published by Friday afternoon; delegations worked from Thursday's text.

tldr.hook: A Russian cruise missile came down in Poland; Tusk called a security council.
points: Tusk convened a state security council after Russian weapons entered Polish territory.
Tusk called it a deliberate provocation; it happened during a massive air raid on western Ukraine.
It fell in a field; two airports paused.

tldr.hook: Japan's inflation rose to 2.3% in October on food and energy costs.
points: Energy costs, reduced subsidies and a weak yen pushed up prices, including food.
The pickup boosts the likelihood of an interest rate hike.
Japanese officials are expected to hike interest rates in December.

tldr.hook: Kenya began drilling for oil in Turkana; first crude is due on 1 December 2026.
points: Gulf Energy runs the South Lokichar project and targets 20,000 barrels per day from 2026 to 2032.
Four names for the crude are under consideration, among them Great Rift Light.
Crude will move by road from Turkana to the Port of Mombasa for shipping to refineries.

tldr.hook: Russian attack on Sknyliv railway station in Lviv killed two and injured at least four.
points: A drone damaged three houses and a car in a Zolochiv district village; another person was injured.
A Stryi district energy facility was damaged. Emergency power outages are in effect in the oblast.
Debris from a Russian missile and drone was found on two streets in Lviv.

tldr.hook: China kept its one-year loan prime rate at 3.0% and five-year at 3.5% for an 18th month.
points: A Reuters survey of 28 respondents found 23 expected no change and five forecast a cut.
October factory output slowed and consumption was subdued, signs of renewed weakness.
The LPR follows PBoC policy moves; the main daily operation is now overnight reverse repo at 1.25%.

points: The Nikkei 225 fell 5.06% to 56,436.65 as Asian chip stocks followed US AI selling.
CNBC attributes the fall to SoftBank's OpenAI bets and its stake in Arm.
The next Bank of Japan decision is on 18 December; traders expect a rise to 1.5%.

tldr.hook: Cyclone Akvan crossed near Gopalpur and weakened; Ganjam's Patrapur got 209 mm of rain.
points: Winds were 70-80 kmph, gusting up to 90 kmph during the landfall.
Odisha evacuated around 3.72 lakh people, deployed 423 rescue teams and set up 9,341 shelters.
No casualties were reported; IMD forecast heavy rain in south Bengal till Saturday morning.

tldr.hook: Israeli aircraft struck eastern Lebanon and the south; five strikes hit near Janta.
points: The Israeli army said the Janta site was used by Hezbollah to make missiles and store weapons.
In the south, drones hit Shuqin and Nabatieh al-Fawqa; eight artillery shells hit toward Khiam.
Attacks came despite a June 26 framework agreement between Beirut and Tel Aviv mediated by the US.

tldr.hook: Uganda's health ministry told police to halt rallies in Ebola high-risk border districts.
points: Charles Olaro asked police chief Abas Byakagaba to require written clearance for gatherings.
The National Task Force kept the suspension of gatherings until further notice after a Nov 3 review.
DRC had 11,197 confirmed cases and 5,471 related deaths as of Nov 12 across eight provinces.

tldr.hook: Malawi fuel shortages force motorists to wait hours or all night for petrol.
points: Filling stations have seen scuffles and violence as drivers compete for scarce fuel.
Blantyre mayor sued for assault after a fuel-queue incident; attendant killed by vehicle.
Petrol costs about $3.24 per litre, more than double the global average of about $1.52.

tldr.hook: AfDB: 22 African countries face debt distress, 14 at high risk.
points: The AfDB's November 2026 report says eight countries were already in debt distress as of July 2026.
About $87 billion left Africa in interest costs from 2022 to 2024.
Six African countries restructured debt since 2020; G20 Common Framework progress is slow.

tldr.hook: George Russell set the fastest time in wet second practice for the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
points: Russell's 1m47.272s at the chequered flag put him 0.071s ahead of Pierre Gasly.
Track was damp and cold, as low as 11C, and rain-disrupted FP1 set no lap times.
Max Verstappen reported power problems and ended 13th.

Taiwan's stock market closed out its worst week since 1991; Taiex fell 6.2% Friday.
S&P 500 futures were down 0.7% and Dow futures were flat.
